title: Alibaba Makes Major Official Announcement of Qwen4 Large Model: Core Capabilities Upgraded Across the Board; Qwen App Now Fully Integrated with Preview Version

content_html:
The AI race has welcomed a brand-new iteration of its core architecture. Alibaba recently officially announced that its new-generation Qwen large model, Qwen4, is about to be fully released. As a major upgrade in technical architecture, the new-generation model has achieved significant performance leaps across multiple key dimensions.

Multi-dimensional capabilities evolve across the board, with standout performance on many real-world tasks

According to the core highlights officially disclosed, Qwen4 has made deep advances in multiple underlying capabilities:

Knowledge understanding: It broadens the breadth of the underlying database and semantic parsing, enabling it to handle more complex context and knowledge Q&A.

World perception: It improves comprehensive modeling and multimodal perception capabilities for complex real-world information.

Coding and agents: It achieves significant improvements in code writing, logical reasoning, and the execution performance of automated agents (Agent), delivering outstanding results in multiple real-world task tests.

Preview version launched first, Qwen App fully integrated

Along with the official announcement of the release, to allow users and developers to experience the new model's capabilities as soon as possible, the official core app Qwen App has immediately integrated the preview version of Qwen4-Max. At present, users can go to the Qwen App to get an early taste and experience the new-generation large model's all-new performance in everyday conversations and complex task handling.
